official_description: A parameter that requires power-off was input.
documented_possible_causes: A parameter requiring power-off was changed.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Turn CNC power OFF and ON after the required parameter change, following the maintenance manual.

official_description: Parameter-write-enable is active.
documented_possible_causes: PWE (parameter write enable) is set ON.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: After completing the intended parameter change, set parameter write enable back to OFF and reset as specified by the manual.

official_description: The servo ready signal VRDY of a servo amplifier is OFF although the position-control ready signal PRDY is ON.
documented_possible_causes: Servo amplifier not ready; another servo alarm may be the preceding cause; power magnetic circuit around amplifier; servo amplifier or CNC axis-control hardware fault.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: If another servo alarm is present, troubleshoot the first alarm first. Check the power magnetic circuit around the amplifier and the applicable servo amplifier/CNC axis-control hardware.
source_manual: B-64305EN/03 Appendix A; maintenance section on SV0401

official_description: The combination of the axis-control card and servo software is incorrect.
documented_possible_causes: Incorrect axis-control card; incorrect servo software installed in flash memory.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Verify the installed axis-control card and the servo software installed in flash memory against the machine configuration.

official_description: The servo velocity-control ready signal VRDY is ON although position-control ready PRDY is OFF.
documented_possible_causes: Servo ready-state mismatch between position and velocity control.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Check the servo-control state and follow the FANUC servo troubleshooting procedure for the machine configuration.

official_description: An abnormal load was detected on the servo motor; the manual notes Cs-axis or spindle-positioning cases for T-series configurations.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Investigate the mechanical load and servo system using FANUC servo diagnostics. The alarm can be cancelled by RESET according to the alarm list.

official_description: Position deviation during stopping exceeded the value set in parameter No. 1829.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Check the position deviation and servo tuning/mechanical condition according to the FANUC maintenance procedure; verify parameter No. 1829.

official_description: Position deviation during travel exceeded the value set in parameter No. 1828.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Check the servo system, mechanical load and parameter No. 1828 according to FANUC maintenance procedure.

official_description: The counter for the amount of positional deviation overflowed.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Use FANUC servo diagnostics and maintenance procedures to identify the condition that caused the deviation counter to overflow.

official_description: A velocity exceeding the travel-velocity limit was commanded.
documented_possible_causes: Commanded velocity exceeded the travel velocity limit.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Check the commanded motion and the applicable axis/velocity parameters and correct the program or configuration as required.

official_description: An illegal digital-servo parameter was detected.
documented_possible_causes: Possible causes include an out-of-range motor model setting at parameter 2020, incorrect motor-rotation direction setting at parameter 2022, or other illegal digital-servo parameter settings.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Identify the cause using the FANUC diagnostic information referenced by the alarm list and correct the applicable servo parameters.

official_description: The servo motor overheat condition is detected.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Inspect the servo motor, cooling condition and associated thermal/servo circuitry using the applicable FANUC maintenance procedure.

official_description: The converter is overloaded.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Inspect the converter/power system using FANUC maintenance diagnostics and the applicable drive procedure.

official_description: The converter control-voltage condition is too low.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Check the converter/power-supply system and associated wiring according to the FANUC maintenance procedure.

official_description: The converter DC-link voltage is too low.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Check incoming power, converter and DC-link circuitry according to FANUC maintenance procedure.

official_description: The inverter control-voltage condition is too low.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Check inverter power/control circuitry using FANUC maintenance diagnostics.

official_description: The inverter DC-link voltage is too low.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Check the inverter, DC-link circuit and incoming power according to FANUC maintenance procedure.

official_description: A soft-thermal/overload condition is detected in the servo system.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Check servo load, acceleration/deceleration, mechanical resistance and cooling according to FANUC servo troubleshooting.

official_description: The positive-side stored-stroke check 1 was exceeded.
documented_possible_causes: Commanded or actual axis position exceeded the positive stored-stroke-check-1 limit.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Move the axis back within the permitted travel using the machine's approved recovery procedure; check stored-stroke parameters and machine configuration before resuming.

official_description: The negative-side stored-stroke check 1 was exceeded.
documented_possible_causes: Commanded or actual axis position exceeded the negative stored-stroke-check-1 limit.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Move the axis back within the permitted travel using the machine's approved recovery procedure; check stored-stroke parameters and machine configuration before resuming.

official_description: The positive-side stored-stroke check 2 was exceeded; the manual also describes a positive-direction entry into an inhibited area for applicable chuck/tailstock barrier configurations.
documented_possible_causes: Positive stored-stroke-check-2 violation or applicable barrier violation.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Use the machine's approved recovery procedure to return inside the permitted area and verify stored-stroke/barrier settings.

official_description: The negative-side stored-stroke check 2 was exceeded; the manual also describes a negative-direction entry into an inhibited area for applicable chuck/tailstock barrier configurations.
documented_possible_causes: Negative stored-stroke-check-2 violation or applicable barrier violation.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Use the machine's approved recovery procedure to return inside the permitted area and verify stored-stroke/barrier settings.

official_description: The positive-side stored-stroke check 3 was exceeded.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Use the machine's approved recovery procedure and verify the relevant stored-stroke settings.

official_description: The negative-side stored-stroke check 3 was exceeded.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Use the machine's approved recovery procedure and verify the relevant stored-stroke settings.

official_description: The positive-direction stroke-limit switch was triggered; the manual states this alarm is generated when the machine reaches the stroke end.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Follow the machine-specific overtravel recovery procedure; do not bypass the safety limit. Inspect the cause of the excessive travel before returning to production.

official_description: A position-coder error was detected on the analog spindle.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Inspect the analog spindle position coder and associated wiring/connections according to the FANUC spindle maintenance procedure.

official_description: An error occurred while reading data from the SIC-LSI on the analog spindle amplifier side.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Inspect the spindle amplifier and associated spindle-control circuitry according to the FANUC maintenance manual.

official_description: A serial-spindle data error is detected.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: The referenced FANUC alarm list specifies replacing the sensor for this amplifier indication; verify the exact spindle amplifier and machine configuration before replacement.

official_description: A serial-spindle data-transfer error is detected.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: The referenced FANUC alarm list specifies replacing the sensor for this amplifier indication; verify the exact spindle amplifier and machine configuration before replacement.

official_description: A soft-phase error is detected in the serial-spindle system.
documented_possible_causes: Incorrect sensor parameter setting; electrical noise; sensor fault.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Check and correct sensor parameter settings; take action against noise; replace the sensor if required, as specified in the FANUC alarm list.

official_description: The motor position exceeded the safety-speed-zero monitoring width.
documented_possible_causes: Motor position outside the safety-speed-zero monitoring range.
documented_troubleshooting_direction: Perform operation within the safety-speed-zero range, as specified by the FANUC alarm list and applicable machine procedure.
